questions: Are legal sources current and correctly mapped?
Are rule precedence and effective dates defensible?
Are legal limitations and escalation points explicit?
Are Article 5 triggers and exceptions correctly represented?
Are ambiguous cases escalated rather than auto-approved?
Are prohibited outcomes fail-closed?
Is transparency wording accurate and non-misleading?
Are affected-person notices sufficiently clear?
Are language variants materially equivalent?
Does the methodology cover relevant fundamental rights?
Are consultation and mitigation requirements explicit?
Are residual-risk decisions properly escalated?
Are deployer duties separated from provider duties?
Are monitoring and human oversight obligations complete?
Are national-law dependencies identified?
Does Article 10 data governance coverage remain accurate?
Are bias, representativeness and provenance controls sufficient?
Are evidence limitations explicit?
Are conformity pathways and prerequisites correctly modeled?
Are CE marking and registration gates non-automatic?
Are notified-body dependencies correctly represented?
Are GPAI and systemic-risk applicability tests defensible?
Are transparency and copyright obligations represented?
Are provider-specific external obligations clearly bounded?
